test_name: PII Processing and Transparency - PT-3 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Secure-Analytics-151
Primary NIST family: PII Processing and Transparency (PT); evidence focus: PT-3.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: a newly added analytics purpose is approved internally but the public-facing purpose description is awaiting the next release. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
